title: Wholesale Price Waterfall & Channel Margin Stack Calculator

listing.description_html:
Work back from your unit cost through your wholesale price, the distributor and the retailer to the shelf price, and test whether your planned retail price leaves you a margin in every channel.

This calculator takes the margin each channel needs and works the price back from your cost: your wholesale price, the distributor's price, and the retail price needed for everyone to earn their margin. It then compares that required retail price with the one you plan to charge and tells you whether your margin survives, is squeezed, or turns into a loss.

What's included

  • Price waterfall: unit cost to your wholesale price, distributor price and required retail price
  • Your margin at your planned retail price, with a plain verdict for each product
  • Profit per unit wholesale versus direct, and the order-size ratio between them
  • Quick check that splits any shelf price into retailer, distributor and your shares
  • Up to 30 products; summary of products that work, are squeezed or lose money
  • A guide with scenarios, a price-list checklist, a routine and an FAQ

Who it's for

  • Makers, food and beverage brands, cosmetics and goods brands starting to sell wholesale
  • Founders preparing a price list for retailers or distributors
  • Product managers setting MSRP for a new line
  • Buyers and sales reps who need to explain a price quickly

You get: wholesale_price_waterfall_channel_margin.xlsx (Settings, Products, Summary) and a PDF guide.

Works in Excel 2016 or later, Excel for Mac and Excel on the web; opens in Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

This workbook is a pricing calculation tool, not legal, tax or competition-law advice. Retail price floors and resale price maintenance are restricted in some jurisdictions. Check your distribution and retail agreements before you set or enforce prices.
